stemMarkdown: Pipe A can fill a cistern in 10 hours and pipe B can fill it in 17 hours. If both pipes are opened together, how long will they take to fill the cistern? (2 decimal places, in hours.)
solutionMarkdown: A's rate $= 1/10$ of the cistern per hour, B's rate $= 1/17$. Combined rate $= 1/10 + 1/17 = 0.1588$ per hour. Time together $= \dfrac{1}{1/10+1/17} = 6.30$ hours.
